name: znetwork_dplay_pump_incoming_messages
description: zNetworkDPlay::PumpIncomingMessages handles DirectPlay system messages for player join/leave, host promotion, session notifications, session descriptor updates, async send completion, and fatal disconnect.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork DirectPlay receive-pump source-cluster pass; the original function has an MSVC SEH frame and inline string-copy shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48afe0 validates the DirectPlay message switch: type 3 creates and appends a player record then dispatches packet type 2 and host color assignments; type 5 dispatches packet type 3, removes the player record, and decrements the cached count; type 0x31 triggers fatal disconnect and returns -1; type 0x101 sets host state; types 0x102 and 0x103 dispatch packets 4 and 5; type 0x104 copies the session descriptor; type 0x10d marks matching async sends complete; unhandled messages report through zError::ReportOld.

The native zNetwork pump smoke verifies create/leave record ownership and dispatches, host flag, session packet dispatches, session descriptor copy, send-complete handle match, and fatal-disconnect callback/result behavior.
